servicesSection.title: Our services
servicesSection.description: Facial and body treatments and hair removal with professional equipment.

0.title: Facial Treatments
0.content: Discover our facial treatments designed to rejuvenate and revitalize your skin. From deep cleanings to anti-aging treatments, we use high-quality products and advanced techniques to ensure your skin looks and feels incredible.

1.title: Deep Facial Cleansing
1.content: Deep facial hygiene with mechanical or chemical peeling, extraction, personalized mask, appropriate apparatus, and facial massage. Also, milium extraction.

2.title: Facial or Body Radiofrequency
2.content: Facial or body radiofrequency (intensive anti-wrinkle lifting, firming of facial oval, cheekbones, eyelids, etc. Also body flaccidity and cellulite).

3.title: Oxygen Therapy
3.content: Oxygenating skin treatment with purifying and soothing effect. Treats sagging skin and reduces wrinkles, bags, and dark circles, providing the skin with vitamins, amino acids, and hyaluronic acid as needed.

4.title: Customized CASMARA Treatments
4.content: Customized CASMARA treatments with flash effect, botox, seboregulating, oxygenating, with alginate masks containing gold extract, black pearl, goji berries, edelweiss flowers, and seaweed.

5.title: Dermapen or Microneedling Treatment
5.content: Dermapen treatment (wrinkle filling, expression lines, vitamins, firming, botox effect, melasma, acne marks).

6.title: Chemical peel with retinol
6.content: Chemical peel with retinol: anti-blemish, acne, photoaged skin (with vitamin C, kojic acid, salicylic, mandelic, and retinol).

7.title: Body and facial massages
7.content: Our treatments are designed for deep relaxation and oxygenation of the skin. We offer therapeutic, relaxing, anti-cellulite and ciculatory massages that help to remove contractures, relax deeply and also improve circulation and appearance of skin with cellulite.

8.title: Diode laser depilation
8.content: Experience the latest technology in diode laser treatments, to remove hair, folliculitis and improve skin texture. Guaranteed results from the first session, safe and effective treatment.

9.title: Other Treatments
9.content: We offer manicure and pedicure treatments to care for and enhance the beauty of your hands and feet, along with eyelash extensions to elevate your natural look. Our team uses high-quality products to ensure long-lasting and satisfying results.

splitSection.title: Slimming Treatments
splitSection.content: We offer slimming treatments to help you feel good and confident in your body. We also provide personalized treatments with follow-up and healthy eating guidelines.
phases: 2. Eliminating cellulite, reducing localized fat deposits;

newTreatment.content: Exosomes are small vesicles that come from cells, with a high content of proteins, lipids, messenger RNA, mitochondrial RNA, DNA, and various growth factors.
additionalInfo: - Improve stretch marks, scars, acne marks
